proves.claim: with review.relaxRequiredFamily on and a relaxation witness for the item, eligibilityProblem does not refuse a seat of another session for a --review-family item.

verify.logic-review-eligibility.relaxed-.why: A required-family item waited forever when no seat of its family was live; the relaxation witness has to let another session review it.

proves.claim: without a relaxation witness, or with review.relaxRequiredFamily off, eligibilityProblem refuses a seat of another family for a --review-family item with REQUIRED_REVIEW_FAMILY.

verify.logic-review-eligibility.required.why: The relaxation must stay off unless both the setting and a witness hold.
